steps: /studio-lab anonymous, 1440x900 or 1280x720; Snap off; import media/beeps-6s-vp9-opus.webm, move the video clip to 2 s, drag its fade-in handle to 1.000 s
also give the stems clip a 1 s fade-in (audio handle)
hover the clip, then wheel-scroll the timeline horizontally (deltaX ≈ 276 px) until the fade-in handle sits at x≈362, i.e. under the sticky track header (header right edge = 512)
elementFromPoint at the handle centre; then a real mouse drag +40 px starting at that point
bugs.expected: The sticky track header covers clip content scrolled under it: the header is topmost there and pointer input hits the header controls, never a hidden clip
bugs.actual: The video fade handle (z-index 40) and the audio fade handle (z-index 30) paint over the sticky header (teal squares visible on the header) and are topmost for elementFromPoint. The drag at the header spot edited the hidden video clip: Video Fade In 1.000 → 2.000 with an Undo entry. For audio the handle is also topmost; the same drag reported status 'Fade In: 1.000 წმ.' while the value and Undo stayed unchanged (observed, unexplained). Envelope points are correctly covered (header topmost). Mute clicks a few px lower still hit the header. The audio part is pre-existing (gate-83 reviewer M1 class); this round's video handles inherit it Note: '"repro":false' in r3-*.json covers only the Mute-click sub-probe; the reproduction is the pm1b handle probe.

bugs.actual: Confirmed: (a) two same-state exports differ by ±1 LSB (24-bit) in ≈6,400-7,700 samples, only in 2-8 s (the video clip's own-sound span); (b) one hash (3b3010fd…) was produced by both a faded and an unfaded export; (c) ≈10 exports gave 6 distinct hashes, not a demonstrated cycle; (d) per-second diff counts in the fade windows are not elevated (n1-f1 2/3/6/7 s: 564/510/547/541 vs the unchanged control n1-n2: 624/582/621/685). Inference: not caused by the video fade, but 'max difference 0' oracles on spans with video sound are flaky
